Name: Warp To Teammate
Author: neoiw
Description:
[size=6][color=#e8a33d][b]Warp to Teammate — Never Leave Your Friends Behind ([i]Open sourced)[/i][/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]English[/b][/color][/size]

In multiplayer, the
[code]Return Scepter[/code][size=3]now asks where you actually want to go.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Keep the original behavior[/b]: "Return to farm (original)" is exactly the vanilla warp, animation, sound, and delay.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Warp to any online teammate[/b]: each teammate appears as an option; pick one and you are carried across maps to the nearest legal standing tile near them.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Native question UI[/b]: uses Stardew's own dialogue box, so it feels like part of the game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Split-screen safe[/b]: only one local warp menu at a time; if another local player already has the menu open, your scepter falls back to the vanilla farm return.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Single-player untouched[/b]: vanilla behavior exactly.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]Why it feels vanilla[/b][/color][/size]

[size=3]The mod does not add new items, new maps, or new UI chrome. It only adds a small, meaningful choice before the Return Scepter fires, and reproduces the original warp effects even when you teleport to a teammate—flash, particles, sound, and the one-second delayed warp.[/size]

[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]Requirements & Install[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0.0+[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install: extract the[/size]
[code]WarpToTeammate[/code][size=3]folder into[/size]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][size=3], launch with SMAPI, no setup needed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Online co-op: the host and every farmhand must install the mod.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]Multiplayer notes[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Works in split-screen, LAN, and online co-op.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Teammates in events, in bed, swimming, or in the bath are hidden from the list.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If no teammate is online, the scepter keeps its vanilla behavior (no menu).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If a teammate's current room is not yet loaded on your split-screen instance, the mod resolves it by network location name and picks the landing tile after the map loads.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[color=#888888][size=2][i]Open source under GPL-3.0. Small, focused, easy to fork.[/i][/size][/color]

[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]中文[/b][/color][/size]

[size=3]多人模式下，[/size]
[code]回程魔杖[/code][size=3]会先问你要去哪里。[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]保留原版行为[/b]：“返回农场（原功能）”就是原版传送，动画、音效、延迟完全一样。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]传送到任意在线队友[/b]：每个队友一个选项，选中后跨地图传送到他们附近最近的合法可站立格。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]原生问答界面[/b]：使用星露谷自己的对话框，像游戏原生功能一样。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]分屏安全[/b]：同一时刻只开一个本地传送菜单；另一个本地玩家已开着菜单时，你的魔杖会回退到原版返回农场。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]单人模式不动[/b]：原版行为完全保留。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]为什么感觉像原版[/b][/color][/size]

[size=3]Mod 不添加新物品、新地图或新 UI 外壳，只在回程魔杖触发前增加一个有意义的选项；即使传送到队友身边，也会复刻原版光效、粒子、音效和 1 秒延迟。[/size]

[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]环境与安装[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]星露谷物语 1.6+ 和 SMAPI 4.0.0+[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]安装：把[/size]
[code]WarpToTeammate[/code][size=3]文件夹解压到[/size]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][size=3]，用 SMAPI 启动即可，无需配置。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]在线联机：主机和每位农场客都必须安装本 Mod。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#4da6ff][b]联机说明[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]支持分屏、局域网和互联网联机。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]过场/事件、睡觉、游泳/洗澡中的队友不会出现在列表。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]没有队友在线时，魔杖保持原版行为（不弹菜单）。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]如果队友当前所在房间在分屏实例中尚未加载，Mod 会按网络位置名解析，并在地图加载后选择落点。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[color=#888888][size=2][i]开源，GPL-3.0。小巧、聚焦、便于 fork。[/i][/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Warp to Teammate
Manifest.Description: Adds a warp destination menu to the Return Scepter in multiplayer: keep the original farm return or teleport next to any online teammate. Supports split-screen, LAN and online co-op.
Manifest.Author: Braveturtle
